aiDecision.thesis: 1M UNI (~$6.4M) into Binance via a deposit address is real supply, but it is only ~0.1% of supply and ~0.6% of UNI's $1.05B daily volume. Modeled impact of 0.6% sits far inside UNI's 7.6% daily sigma, so the signal is indistinguishable from noise. The depositor is a nonce-1 pass-through wallet with no team/treasury/unlock provenance, consistent with custody or OTC routing.
aiDecision.invalidation: Further deposits from the same or sibling wallets totalling >5M UNI, or attribution of the wallet to a team/treasury/unlock schedule, would make the supply material and justify a short.
aiDecision.rationale: Block size is immaterial against UNI's deep liquidity: modeled 0.6% move is under one-tenth of daily volatility, so realised PnL would be dominated by noise rather than the flow. Provenance is also unestablished — a single-transaction wallet forwarding its entire balance through a deposit address is as likely to be custody/OTC settlement as it is a seller. Both the size test and the intent test fail.

aiDecision.thesis: 620k LINK (~$7.6M) to a Coinbase deposit address is only ~1.7% of LINK's $447M daily volume and 0.062% of supply. Modeled impact of 0.495% sits far inside a 3.8% daily sigma, so any sell pressure is indistinguishable from noise in one of the deepest alt markets. The depositor is also a 4-tx pass-through EOA, a pattern equally consistent with custody/OTC settlement as with a seller.
aiDecision.invalidation: Further deposits from linked wallets pushing the block above ~5% of daily volume, or attribution of 0xf5b0 to a team/treasury/unlock wallet with a sell history, would make the supply thesis actionable.
aiDecision.rationale: Supply-to-exchange is plausible but unproven: a 4-transaction EOA forwarding its entire balance through an intermediary deposit address is as likely a custody hop or OTC leg as a liquidation. Even if sold, $7.6M into $447M daily volume moves LINK less than one-eighth of a daily sigma, so the modeled edge is dominated by ordinary price noise. Size and identity both fail the bar; stand down.

aiDecision.thesis: A 4-tx EOA moving 63.7% of its SHIB balance to Coinbase does look like genuine supply rather than market-maker flow, but $1.12M is only ~1.4% of SHIB's $79.6M daily volume and 0.022% of supply. The implied 0.51% impact sits far inside a 4.33% daily sigma and is indistinguishable from noise.
aiDecision.invalidation: Further deposits from this or related dormant wallets pushing cumulative supply toward a multi-percent share of daily volume, or SHIB breaking down on visible sell pressure post-deposit.
aiDecision.rationale: Depositor profile supports real supply, but the block is too small relative to SHIB liquidity to move price reliably; modeled edge is a fraction of daily volatility and the market has just moved up ~1%, so any short is a coin flip on noise rather than on the flow.

aiDecision.thesis: Depositor 0xf977814e90da44bfa03b6295a0616a897441acec is Binance's own well-known hot/cold wallet (Binance 8), with 20,534 transactions and constant flow. A 2M LINK transfer to a Binance hub address is an internal exchange rebalance, not new sell-side supply from a team, treasury or unlock.
aiDecision.invalidation: Evidence the depositor is an identified team/treasury/fund wallet rather than a Binance-controlled address, or LINK begins breaking down on visible orderbook sell pressure.
aiDecision.rationale: Exchange-to-exchange internal movement fails the supply test: no beneficial owner is liquidating. Modeled 0.87% impact also sits barely above the 0.38% edge floor against 4.1% daily sigma and $513M volume, so even a genuine block would be noise-dominated. Market has not moved, consistent with participants reading this as an internal transfer.

aiDecision.thesis: A 2M UNI ($13.3M) deposit to Binance is only 5.5% of this wallet's 36.5M UNI balance and 0.2% of supply, from an EOA with 5,461 transactions — an operationally active large holder, not a one-off unlock or treasury liquidation. Modeled impact of 0.94% is well inside one daily sigma (6.98%) on $736M of real volume.
aiDecision.invalidation: A much larger follow-on deposit (material share of the 36.5M balance) or repeated deposits into weakening spot price would re-open the short case.
aiDecision.rationale: Supply signal is weak: small share of balance sent, tiny share of supply, high-frequency wallet consistent with market making or routine flow. Impact math (0.94%) barely clears the 0.39% edge floor and is dwarfed by daily volatility, while price has already moved +4.8% in the last two hours against a short entry. Risk of shorting into strength for a sub-sigma edge is not justified.

aiDecision.thesis: The depositor is a high-frequency flow wallet (245k transactions, balance lower than the amount forwarded), consistent with a market maker or exchange-operated address rather than team, treasury or unlock supply. A $3.1M deposit into $1.6B daily UNI volume models only a 0.45% impact, below any tradeable edge.
aiDecision.invalidation: A long-dormant or labelled team/treasury/fund wallet sending a block that is material versus UNI daily volume, with no offsetting withdrawal pattern.
aiDecision.rationale: Not real sellable supply: 245k-tx non-contract address behaving as a conduit, 0.036% of supply, negligible modeled impact (0.445%) versus an already +8% two-hour move which is the wrong direction for a short entry anyway. No causal path from this deposit to a price decline.
